name: X-FACTR
description: X-FACTR is a multilingual benchmark designed to evaluate pretrained language models' ability to retrieve factual knowledge across 23 typologically diverse languages using cloze-style probes. It includes multi-word entity probing and decoding algorithms to handle multi-token predictions.
reputation: A well-known multilingual factual probing benchmark that has been widely used to study cross-lingual knowledge transfer and multilingual LM factual recall.
notes: Focuses on multilingual factual knowledge retrieval; includes code-switching methods to improve multilingual LMs; benchmark data and code publicly released.
